newsitem.title: USA: Rite Aid sets $1.0 bln three-part debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Rite Aid sets $1.0 bln three-part debt issue.

text.p: Rite Aide's multi-tranche corporate debt offering was increased in size from an initial $600 million to one billion to meet strong investor demand, syndicate sources said.
The following multi-tranche debt offering from Rite Aid Corp was priced on Tuesday, according to sources close to the deal.
